generation.scope: On the fifteen-dimensional unmarked component, one projected twenty-point configuration determines generically finitely many windows, of even function-field degree by reversal. The embedded first-edge and first-configuration images have dimensions 45 and 30. All four normalized square roots are isolated and reduced at the full-rank sample. At the symmetric sample the even root has exact local length two, and the odd roots are reduced.

proof_review.scope: Reviewed the fixed-edge Jacobian and fixed-configuration incidences, reversal invariance and generic freeness on the fiber, characteristic-zero lower tangent bound at collision, and exact second-order obstruction. The differential to the first configuration is injective modulo projective orbits; its generic stabilizer is trivial.

mathematical_computation.scope: Exact first-edge tangents, ranks of 60 by 96 first-coordinate incidence matrices, all four square-root Jacobians, and the nonzero quadratic obstruction at the rank-ten root.

open_mathematics: Determine the exact generic degree over a single projected configuration. Normalize Q=A^2 and Q-perp, enumerate isolated Grassmann square roots up to coordinate signs, reject pairs by the cubic intersection, then recover the two-window extension. Determine the quartic center and effective regularity on the full component and the remaining singular rank charts.
